newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Keppel Marine units get new names.
newsitem.headline: Keppel Marine units get new names.

text.p: Keppel Marine Industries Ltd, part of Keppel Corp, said on Wednesday its four units would take new names with immediate effect.
Keppel Singmarine Dockyard Pte Ltd, formerly Singmarine Dockyard & Engineering Pte Ltd;
Keppel Slag Pte Ltd, formerly Slag Industries (1985) Pte Ltd;
Keppel Markem Pte Ltd, formerly Mar-Kem (Far East) Pte Ltd, and Keppel Eagle (Pte) Ltd, which replaces Western Eagle (Pte) Ltd.
The move is in line with the change in name and corporate identity recently in the Keppel group of companies.
